issue.title: Point links at the renamed repo, lumencell-app
issue.body:
## Summary

The repo is now shreyandhawa/lumencell-app (lumencell was taken by an older private repo). README image links updated; the old URLs still redirect.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** README

The publish workflow was not changed. If PyPI trusted publishing is bound to the old repo name, the next release needs the publisher entry updated to lumencell-app.
